commit.subject: LU-20931 lnet: honor export output file for peer configuration
commit.message:
LU-20931 lnet: honor export output file for peer configuration

yaml_lnet_peer() receives the selected output stream, but its
display helper writes to stdout. Pass the stream through so
exporting to a named file includes the peer configuration.

Add sanity-lnet test 0a to compare named-file and redirected
exports and check that named-file export leaves stdout empty.

Change-Id: I2e6db4ddeedda4d5eacae6211dc3e0340a219784
Signed-off-by: Matt Dube <mdube@ddn.com>
Test-Parameters: trivial
